standard_prerequisites.use: The characterization of normal morphisms (lemma-normal, same chapter), smoothness implies finite presentation, flatness, and stability of smoothness under base change, and smooth over a field is geometrically normal (Varieties); each is cited with its lemma in the retained span.

core_obligations: Deduce from smoothness that f is locally of finite presentation, hence the fibres are locally of finite type over fields and locally Noetherian.
Cite that a smooth morphism is flat.
Deduce that the fibres, being smooth over fields, are geometrically normal.
Apply the characterization lemma for normal morphisms to conclude.

proof_roadmap.step: Verify finiteness and flatness hypotheses of the normal-morphism criterion with citations.
Identify the fibres as geometrically normal and apply the criterion.

difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies smooth morphisms among normal morphisms. The proof verifies each hypothesis of the characterization lemma for normal morphisms with an explicit citation: smooth implies locally of finite presentation so the fibres are locally Noetherian, smooth implies flat, and the fibres are smooth over fields hence geometrically normal. The reduction into the cited characterization is written step by step. Retained author proof at lines 5557-5570.
